description: A live Model switch the CLI refuses: query.setModel rejects, so the driver writes a switchyard/set_model_failed line with the CLI's message and the adapter sends model_change_failed with that reason. The main agent stays on claude-opus-5-5, and its next request is not a second failure. Synthesised from the Agent SDK 0.3.300 message types (paired with Claude Code 2.1.300), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture made with SWITCHYARD_RECORD_DIR (see sidecar/README.md).
